messages.content: Manager froze. How to diagnose?

Check /proc/<pid>/wchan — if it says locks_lock_inode_wait, it's stuck on a flock. lsof the lock file to see who holds it. If the lock is on a (deleted) inode, someone rm'd and recreated the file — the old holder locks a ghost. Fix: kill the stuck process, delete and recreate the lock file.
Two Managers running. How?

Singleton guard uses flock on manager.lock. If someone deletes and recreates the file, old Manager holds lock on deleted inode, new Manager locks the new file. Both think they're alone. Fix: singleton guard must verify inode after flock — fstat(fd) vs stat(path), retry if mismatched.
Build failed with ParticleEffect errors.

Common: SetColorStart/SetColorEnd don't exist. Use SetNumColorFrames(N) + SetColorFrame(i, ColorFrame(color, time)). Clone() returns SharedPtr<ParticleEffect>, not raw pointer — use SharedPtr<ParticleEffect> not auto*.
Fish all cluster in one spot.

CreateFish picks random indices from waterPoints — they cluster. Fix: stride through the list evenly. stride = waterPoints.Size() / NUM_FISH. Each fish gets baseIdx = i * stride with jitter ±half stride. Same fix for CreateSchoolFish school centers.
Spawned coder can't assume role — flock fails.

Manager holds flock on assume.lock, child inherits the fd. Linux flock is per-open-file-description — child's new fd deadlocks against inherited fd. Fix: O_CLOEXEC on Manager's open(), and close_inherited_flocks() in the shell script before flock.
Pipeline cache serving old shaders.

After editing any GLSL shader and rebuilding, delete ~/.local/share/urho3d/pipeline_cache.bin. Stale cache serves old SPIR-V bytecode. The cache is valid optimization but must be invalidated on shader changes.
libUrho3D.a corrupted — linker says 'no more archived files'.
In-place ar merge can scramble member boundaries. Delete the archive, rebuild from scratch: rm build/lib/libUrho3D.a && safe_build.sh <target>
Vulkan swapchain out of date on resize.

OnWindowResized_Vulkan sets resizePending_. BeginFrame_Vulkan calls RecreateSwapchainResources. If AcquireNextImage returns OutOfDate, it recreates again. Both paths call ResetRenderTargets_Vulkan and send E_SCREENMODE. If it still fails: check vkDeviceWaitIdle isn't hanging, check surface recreation.
NPC fishing gives fish but ignores actual fish in water.

NPCFish is a pure d20 roll — no awareness of fish entities. Fish are client-only decoration. Server needs lazy fish zones: dormant by default, activate when trap placed or NPC fishes nearby. Zone tracks lightweight fish positions, deactivates after 60s idle. TickWaterTraps checks zone fish, not flat DC.
Yuki crashed in libggml-base.so.

Signal 6 (ABRT) = ggml assertion failed. Check coredumpctl info <pid> for thread + stack. Common causes: stale llama.cpp build against newer API, model file incompatibility, thread safety issue in background inference. Fix: clean rebuild of llama.cpp (rm -rf build, cmake, make). Check model GGUF version matches ggml expectations.
